proposed_new_terms.definition: The memoized collection of all Command objects assembled from built-in, skill-directory, plugin, bundled, and MCP sources, filtered by availability and feature gates.
The isBridgeSafeCommand function that classifies commands into three tiers (prompt=safe, local-jsx=blocked, local=allowlist) for remote execution authorization.
The precedence mechanism where commands loaded earlier in the array take priority over later commands with the same name during findCommand lookup.
